Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.
inputs.nonce_note: The app generates a fresh UUID when staging; the unsigned public confirmation does not expose it. After any later human-approved send, bind the public recovery export to exact receipt calldata, extract and validate request_id, and compute the expected review ID and call digest. No exact nonce, review ID or call digest is claimed at preflight.
inputs.expected_supported_quote: Refund requests must be submitted within 14 days of purchase.
inputs.expected_unchanged: Owner, roles, invitations, ownership proposal, reference bundles, both answer cards, and all nine pre-existing complete reviews with their original timestamp strings.
inputs.expected_new_review_timestamp: Use the stored recorded_at after final successful execution; do not derive it from the local clock.

expected_user_action: Review the public fictional 14-day answer, tick the public-content consent, Continue to wallet, and approve only this new ReplyCheck review in MetaMask from B on Studionet. Do not refresh or send another action. Agent will observe a hash and actual lifecycle status before reloading. Reply done after approving.
controlled_reload_scope: Record the known fictional draft and any returned hash. If necessary to avoid the unsaved-draft browser prompt, clear only these known draft inputs after the wallet returns a hash, then reload the same sender page and re-enter them. Recovery metadata is never manually cleared. This is not an automatic draft-persistence test.
expected_result: A hash-bound recovery record survives same-tab reload without another wallet request. If genuinely unfinalized before reload, capture actual pre/post lifecycle evidence; otherwise label only already-finalized recovery. After strict exact successful execution, verify source, final leader output and the predeclared one-review-only delta, including all unchanged full history and raw stored timestamps.
